item.text:
## 2B.4 Research Note: Lula, Brazil, 2024

**Bottom line:** I found **mostly positive indirect evidence**. Lula did not command a major Brazilian kinetic campaign in 2024, so the lens is mainly about how he handled others’ wars. In that setting, he repeatedly backed ceasefires, hostage release, aid access, and civilian protection. The main caveat is that his Gaza rhetoric was highly confrontational, but the policy line still favored humanitarian restraint.

### Accepted claims

- **Claim:** Brazil joined a Gaza statement calling for ceasefire, hostage release, and humanitarian aid.
  - **Title:** [Brasil assina declaração conjunta pelo fim dos ataques sobre Gaza](https://agenciagov.ebc.com.br/noticias/202406/declaracao-conjunta-sobre-gaza)
  - **Publisher:** Agência Gov / MRE
  - **Date:** June 6, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://agenciagov.ebc.com.br/noticias/202406/declaracao-conjunta-sobre-gaza
  - **Claim-level summary:** The joint declaration says Israel and Hamas must cease hostilities in Rafah, release hostages immediately and unconditionally, and allow humanitarian aid to civilians. This is strong evidence of civilian-protection and humanitarian-law alignment.
  - **Question IDs:** `2B.4`; also `1B.8`, `2B.1`

- **Claim:** Lula publicly said he opposed war in general and favored a Palestinian state and peace in Gaza and Ukraine.
  - **Title:** [Lula repeats that the Israeli government commits genocide in Gaza and defends the creation of a Palestinian state](https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/02/23/lula-repete-que-governo-israelense-comete-genocidio-em-gaza-e-defende-criacao-de-estado-palestino.htm)
  - **Publisher:** Reuters via UOL
  - **Date:** February 23, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/02/23/lula-repete-que-governo-israelense-comete-genocidio-em-gaza-e-defende-criacao-de-estado-palestino.htm
  - **Claim-level summary:** Lula reiterated that he was against war generally, defended Palestinian statehood, and denounced civilian suffering in Gaza. The rhetoric was sharp, but the underlying policy position was anti-war and pro-civilian protection.
  - **Question IDs:** `2B.4`; also `1B.2`, `1B.8`

- **Claim:** Lula told Blinken he wanted peace and an end to the Gaza and Ukraine conflicts.
  - **Title:** [Lula said he discussed peace in Ukraine and Gaza with Antony Blinken](https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/02/21/lula-diz-que-discutiu-conflitos-em-gaza-e-na-ucrania-em-encontro-com-blinken.htm)
  - **Publisher:** Reuters via UOL
  - **Date:** February 21, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/02/21/lula-diz-que-discutiu-conflitos-em-gaza-e-na-ucrania-em-encontro-com-blinken.htm
  - **Claim-level summary:** Planalto said Lula reaffirmed his desire for peace and an end to the conflicts, including support for a Palestinian state. That is consistent with a restraint-first approach rather than acceptance of indiscriminate military force.
  - **Question IDs:** `2B.4`; also `1B.8`, `2B.1`

- **Claim:** Brazil supported a Ukraine peace formula built around direct talks and a comprehensive ceasefire.
  - **Title:** [Brazil and China sign joint proposal for peace negotiation in the Russia-Ukraine war](https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/05/23/brasil-e-china-assinam-proposta-conjunta-de-negociacao-de-paz-para-guerra-da-ucrania-e-russia.htm)
  - **Publisher:** Reuters via UOL
  - **Date:** May 23, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/05/23/brasil-e-china-assinam-proposta-conjunta-de-negociacao-de-paz-para-guerra-da-ucrania-e-russia.htm
  - **Claim-level summary:** The statement said dialogue and negotiation were the only viable solution and called for conditions to resume direct talks and move toward a comprehensive ceasefire. That is consistent with proportionality- and civilian-protection-minded de-escalation.
  - **Question IDs:** `2B.4`; also `1B.1`, `1B.8`, `2B.1`

### Counterevidence / caveats

- **Claim:** Lula’s Gaza rhetoric was highly escalatory and triggered a diplomatic rupture, even though it did not endorse civilian harm.
  - **Title:** [Brazil will not retract Lula's Gaza comments in diplomatic row with Israel - sources](https://theprint.in/world/brazil-will-not-retract-lulas-gaza-comments-in-diplomatic-row-with-israel-sources/1972033/)
  - **Publisher:** Reuters via ThePrint
  - **Date:** February 20, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://theprint.in/world/brazil-will-not-retract-lulas-gaza-comments-in-diplomatic-row-with-israel-sources/1972033/
  - **Claim-level summary:** Lula compared Israel’s action in Gaza to Hitler’s treatment of Jews, causing a diplomatic row. This is the main negative item, but it is rhetoric about civilian harm, not evidence that Lula endorsed unlawful military operations.
  - **Question IDs:** `2B.4`; also `1B.2`, `1B.8`

### Search gap

I found **no direct Brazilian military-operation case** in 2024 where Lula had to apply rules of necessity, proportionality, prisoner treatment, or targeting. Brazil was not conducting a large kinetic war that year, so this lens is mostly inferred from:
- support for ceasefire and hostage release,
- humanitarian aid access,
- anti-war statements,
- and the absence of evidence for Brazilian unlawful force.

If you want, I can next convert the 2B series into a compact comparative memo with one verdict per lens.
